title: The Broken Semester
author: Casper Brightwater
blurb: Ulyana Dravenmoor, a debate champion who can't win the argument at home, has spent three years being so careful it hurts. But when the college essay prompt asks one honest question nobody can stop answering, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must save the tradition that made the town before graduation.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
